entries.german:
Hermannus, abbas Zabrdowicensis , donat quasdam vineas in Schatow conventui Lucensi.

cm. Hermannus, abbas Zabrdowicensis, donat quasdam vineas in Schatow conventui Lucensi. Acta in Luka III. Kalend. Junii 1316. \os Hermannus Äliseracione Diuina Abbas Zabardowicensis Monasterij Ordinis Premonstratensis olomucensis dyocesis, Notum facimus vniuersis presentes litteras inspecturis quod vineas nostras quarum vna Regis dicitur, que Antiqua Crucifera nuncupatur Sitas in monte Comitis pertinentes in Schatow quas denarijs nostris diligencia venerabilis fratris nostri Johannis Abbatis quondam patris nostri tali condicione comparauimus, quod licet nobis easdem cum placeret fratrum dicti conuentus pittanciam accedente ad hoc consensu prefati domini Lucensis Abbatis perpetuum deputare, ipsas vineas eisdem fratribus suis seu con ventui ex nunc ad dictum pittanciam libere resignamus. Nos vero Johannes eadem Miseracione Diuina Abbas Lucensis predictas eandem donacionem dilectis fratribus nostris a prescripto venerabile fratre nostro domino Hermano abbate Zabardowicensi ex nunc ut ab olim factam ratihabicione ad ipsorum pittanciam perpetuam confirmamus presentes nostris sigillis pro testimonio consignantes. Datum in Luca Anno Domini Millesimo Trecentesimo Sextodecimo III° Kalendas Junij. (Orig. membran. cum duobus sigillis ruptis in archivo monasterii Lucensis apud C. B. Gubern. Brmi»' sub lit. H. n. 13.)
entries.english:
Hermann, abbot of Žabrdovice, gives certain vineyards at Šatov to the convent of Louka.

CIII. Hermann, abbot of Žabrdovice, gives certain vineyards at Šatov to the convent of Louka. Done at Louka on 30 May 1316.

We, Hermann, by divine mercy abbot of the Premonstratensian monastery of Žabrdovice in the diocese of Olomouc, make known to all who see this letter that we freely transfer to our brethren, the convent of Louka, for their perpetual refectory endowment, the vineyards we own at Šatov on the Count’s Hill, one of which is called Regis and the other is now called Antiqua Crucifera. We bought them with our own money through the diligence of our venerable brother John, formerly our abbot, on the condition that we might assign them permanently to the refectory of the brethren of that convent whenever we wished, with the consent of the aforesaid lord abbot of Louka.

Accordingly, we now freely transfer those vineyards to the same brethren, for their refectory. We, John, by the same divine mercy abbot of Louka, confirm as a permanent endowment for the refectory of our beloved brethren this donation made by our aforesaid venerable brother, Lord Hermann, abbot of Žabrdovice, and acknowledge it as having been made from the beginning. In witness of this, we have authenticated this letter with our seals. Given at Louka in the year of the Lord 1316, on the third day before the Kalends of June.

[Original parchment with two broken seals in the archive of the monastery of Louka at C. B. Gubern., Brno, under H. no. 13.]
